//: Emit config for the VENDORED copy. The lab has no build step: it runs its .ts
sources directly under Node 24 type stripping. cedrus-backend cannot rely on
that (package.json declares node >=20, and a type-stripping floor is a
deploy-time failure mode, not a test-time one), so the vendored copy is
compiled to plain ES2023 JavaScript at vendor time and the backend imports
dist/. See VENDORED_FROM.md for the decision and what it costs.
rewriteRelativeImportExtensions rewrites the sources' .ts specifiers to .js in
the emitted output, so the source stays byte-comparable with the lab.
